title: Iron Hill Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Our programs focus on earth science, archaeology, Native American studies, natural history, and paleontology as they relate to Delaware and the region. The Iron Hill Museum programs address State of Delaware Curriculum Framework standards and benchmarks. If you can't come to see us, we can go to you! Don’t forget to check out our Outreach Programs. Field trip cost: $6.00 per student. There is a reduced rate of $5.00 per student when program is scheduled for the afternoon on weekdays. Exceptions to this price is our Earth Science + Collect program. This is $7.50 per student. More payment information about Earth Science + Collect is listed below with the description of the tour.
